About This Site

Akamai’s services have been architected with redundancies and automatic failover to ensure optimal availability, protection, and performance. When issues arise, we are committed to delivering clear, transparent information to maintain trust and the highest possible quality of service. In the interest of time, we are providing you the most current information available, which is subject to changes, corrections and updates. If you are experiencing issues with an Akamai service and do not see a notice posted below, please contact Akamai Technical Support.

Details about incidents that impact multiple customers will be posted on the Akamai Community "Service Incident Notifications" group. Only customers and partners with valid Akamai Control Center login credentials will have access to that group.

Nov 10, 2026

Customer Security Advisory: Critical F5/NGINX Out-of-Band Vulnerabilities
Resolved - Akamai has completed its investigation of the recently published F5/NGINX vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-15176, CVE-2026-97205, and CVE-2026-93479). We have not identified any impact to Akamai’s platform or infrastructure, and services remain operating normally.If you run a vulnerable version of NGINX Open Source or NGINX Plus on a Linode instance, follow F5/NGINX guidance and apply the available patches.Customers and partners with a valid Control Center login can find more details at https://community.akamai.com/customers/s/group/0F90f000000DFgx/service-incident-notifications, or by reaching out to Akamai Support. Thank you for your patience and continued support.

Investigating - Akamai is aware of the recently published F5/NGINX vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-15176, CVE-2026-97205, and CVE-2026-93479), and our teams are investigating their potential impact across our platform and infrastructure.F5 has released out-of-band security patches addressing three critical severity vulnerabilities in NGINX Open Source and NGINX Plus. These vulnerabilities may allow unauthenticated attackers to trigger heap buffer overflows, which could cause a denial of service or potential remote code execution if ASLR is bypassed.If you are running a vulnerable version of NGINX Open Source or NGINX Plus, we recommend following guidance from F5/NGINX and applying available patches.We will post more details for customers and partners with a valid Control Center login at https://community.akamai.com/customers/s/group/0F90f000000DFgx/service-incident-notifications as additional information becomes available. Performance Degradation for Customers in Mumbai and Chennai
Resolved - We can confirm that the issue was mitigated at 17:15 UTC on November 2, 2026 and the service has resumed normal operation. Customers and partners can view additional details about the incident by logging in to: or reaching out to Akamai Support. We apologize for the impact and thank you for your patience and continued support. Nov 9, 19:24 UTC
Investigating - On October 27, 2026, between 08:05 UTC and 10:45 UTC customers using services in Mumbai and Chennai may have experienced performance degradation. Property Manager Property Activation Errors
Resolved - We became aware of an issue with Property Manager related to activating properties with errors indicating "cloudlet policy not found or not valid" blocking some property activations. The issue lasted between approximately 15:30 UTC on November 3, 2026 and 17:15 UTC on November 3, 2026. We can confirm that the issue is now resolved, and the service has resumed normal operation. Customers and partners can view additional details about the incident by logging in to: https://community.akamai.com/customers/s/feed/0D5a700001cwVdYCAU or reaching out to Akamai Support. We apologize for the impact and thank you for your patience and continued support. Customer Security Advisory: Brotli Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities [CVE-2026-111497]
Resolved - As of November 2, 2026, at approximately 23:00 UTC, we completed all platform hardening measures to fully mitigate Akamai's potential exposure to the Brotli Remote Code Execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-111497). All systems are secured, and we have detected no evidence of unauthorized access or impact to customer environments.
